text: Meeting deadlines can feel stressful, but good planning makes it easier. The first step is time management: break your work into smaller tasks and set a realistic schedule for each one. Next, practice prioritization by focusing on the most important or urgent items first, rather than doing easy tasks just because they are quick. Another key skill is scope management, which means knowing when to say “no” to extra requests. If a project grows too large, you must adjust your plan or ask for more time. Finally, communication is vital. If you see a problem early, tell your team or manager right away. They can help you find a solution before the deadline arrives.
